description: Use this when the user asks how a competitor advertises, what its ad strategy is, or where the openings against it are. It turns the competitor's ads into a playbook: their opening-hook MIX, longest-running campaign THEMES, the WHITE SPACE nobody in their set runs, 2-3 render-ready COUNTER-PLAYS, and the territories they own that you should avoid. Pass `competitor` {name, domain?}. Pass `ads` (raw ad objects from a prior pull_competitor_ads / search_meta_ads call) to tear down exactly those, or omit it and this pulls the competitor's longest-running Meta ads first. Tailored to the saved brand. Spends credits (free when you pass ads).

ads.description: ad objects to tear down (from pull_competitor_ads / search_meta_ads). Omit to auto-pull their Meta ads first.

domain.description: their domain — sharpens the auto-pull page match

expected_credits.description: the get_cost price; refused unbilled if the live price differs

get_cost.description: true: return the price only; nothing runs or bills

idempotency_key.description: chosen once, resent unchanged on retries: the same key never buys twice

name: competitor_teardown
title: Competitor teardown
